sets.title: Identify the Type
sets.description: Choose the correct participle type for each context
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный тип причастия для каждого контекста

items.prompt: Девушка, _____ письмо, улыбнулась. (who wrote a letter - active, completed)
items.promptEnglish: The girl who wrote a letter smiled.
items.hint: Active (she does the writing) + past perfective (completed).
items.explanation: Active past perfective: написавшая. The girl performed and completed the action.

items.prompt: Письмо, _____ девушкой, лежит на столе. (written by the girl - passive, completed)
items.promptEnglish: The letter written by the girl is on the table.
items.explanation: Passive past: написанное. The letter received the action of writing.

items.prompt: Мужчина, _____ газету, сидит в кафе. (who is reading now - active, ongoing)
items.promptEnglish: The man reading a newspaper is sitting in a cafe.
items.explanation: Active present: читающий. The man performs the action right now.

items.prompt: Проект, _____ командой, будет представлен завтра. (being developed - passive, ongoing)
items.promptEnglish: The project being developed by the team will be presented tomorrow.
items.explanation: Passive present: разрабатываемый. The project is being developed (ongoing).

items.prompt: Туристы, _____ из Москвы, посетили музей. (who arrived - active, completed)
items.promptEnglish: The tourists who arrived from Moscow visited the museum.
items.explanation: Active past perfective: приехавшие. The tourists completed their arrival.

items.prompt: Дом, _____ в прошлом веке, стоит до сих пор. (built - passive, completed)
items.promptEnglish: The house built in the last century still stands.
items.hint: Passive (house received action of building) + past (completed).
items.explanation: Passive past: построенный. The house was built (completed action, passive).

items.prompt: Which participle type replaces 'который читает' (who reads)?
items.promptEnglish: Subject does action, present tense.
items.explanation: Который читает → active present: читающий.

items.prompt: Which participle type replaces 'которую написали' (that was written)?
items.promptEnglish: Object received action, past tense.
items.explanation: Которую написали → passive past: написанная.

items.prompt: Which participle type replaces 'которого все уважают' (who is respected by all)?
items.promptEnglish: Object receives action, present/ongoing.
items.explanation: Которого все уважают → passive present: уважаемый.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort each participle into its type

sets.title: Active or Passive?
sets.description: Distinguish active from passive participles in context

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The student who solved the problem...
minimalPairs.explanation: Active: the student performed the action. Решивший = who solved.

minimalPairs.context: Задача, _____ студентом... (solved by the student - passive)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The problem solved by the student...
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive: the problem received the action. Решённая = that was solved.

minimalPairs.context: Врач, _____ пациента... (who is examining - active present)
minimalPairs.explanation: Active present: the doctor performs the action. Осматривающий = who examines.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The patient being examined by the doctor...
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive present: the patient receives the action. Осматриваемый = being examined.

blanks: Женщина, _____ по телефону, моя коллега. (who is talking - active present)
Документ, _____ директором, лежит на столе. (signed by the director - passive past)
Дети, _____ в парке вчера, промокли. (who were playing - active past)
Проблемы, _____ на совещании, были серьёзные. (being discussed - passive present)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Choosing the correct participle type by context
hints: She IS talking (active, present, fem): from говорить → говорящая.
The document WAS signed (passive, past, masc): from подписать → подписанный.
They WERE playing (active, past, plural): from играть → игравшие.
Problems ARE being discussed (passive, present, plural): from обсуждать → обсуждаемые.
explanations: Active present fem: говорящая (the woman does the talking, it's happening now).
Passive past masc: подписанный (the document received the action, it's completed).
Active past plural: игравшие (the children did the playing, in the past).
Passive present plural: обсуждаемые (the problems receive the action, it's ongoing).

sets.title: Formation Review
sets.description: Match verbs to their participle forms across all four types
sets.descriptionRussian: Соотнесите глаголы с формами причастий всех четырёх типов

items.prompt: Active present of писать:
items.promptEnglish: Who writes/is writing
items.explanation: Active present: пишущий (1st conj: пишут → пишущий).

items.prompt: Active past of прочитать:
items.promptEnglish: Who read (completed)
items.explanation: Active past: прочитавший (past stem + -вший).

items.prompt: Passive past of решить:
items.promptEnglish: That was solved
items.explanation: Passive past: решённый (реш- + -ённый).

items.prompt: Passive present of изучать:
items.promptEnglish: Being studied
items.explanation: Passive present: изучаемый (изучаем + -ый, 1st conj).

items.prompt: Active past of нести (нёс):
items.promptEnglish: Who was carrying
items.explanation: Active past from consonant stem: нёс → нёсший (-ший, not -вший).

items.prompt: Passive past of открыть:
items.promptEnglish: That was opened
items.explanation: Passive past: открытый (-ыть verbs use -тый suffix).

minimalPairs.context: Человек, _____ работу... (who finished - active past pf)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The person who finished the work...
minimalPairs.explanation: Active: the person did the action. Закончивший = who finished.

minimalPairs.context: _____ работа лежит на столе. (finished work - passive past)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The finished work is on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: Passive: the work received the action. Законченная = that was finished.

sets.title: All Four Types Challenge
sets.description: Mixed exercises testing all participle types
sets.descriptionRussian: Смешанные задания по всем типам причастий

items.prompt: Собака, _____ за кошкой, убежала далеко. (who was running - active past impf)
items.promptEnglish: The dog that was chasing the cat ran far away.
items.hint: Active (dog does action) + past impf (was running).
items.explanation: Active past impf: бежавшая (fem, agrees with собака). The dog was running (process).

items.prompt: Торт, _____ мамой, был очень вкусный. (baked by mom - passive past)
items.promptEnglish: The cake baked by mom was very tasty.
items.explanation: Passive past: испечённый (к→ч mutation: испечь → испечённый). The cake was baked.

items.prompt: Песня, _____ по радио, нравится всем. (being played - passive present)
items.promptEnglish: The song being played on the radio is liked by everyone.
items.explanation: Passive present: передаваемая (1st conj: передаваем + -ая). The song is being broadcast.

items.prompt: Врач, _____ пациентов, работает допоздна. (who treats - active present)
items.promptEnglish: The doctor who treats patients works late.
items.hint: Active (doctor does action) + present (ongoing). 2nd conj: лечат → лечащий.
items.explanation: Active present: лечащий (2nd conj: лечат → лечащий). The doctor treats now.

items.prompt: Вопрос _____. (The question is resolved.)
items.promptEnglish: The question is resolved.
items.explanation: Short form predicative: решён (masc, agrees with вопрос).

items.prompt: Дети, _____ на площадке, громко смеются. (who are playing - active present)
items.promptEnglish: The children playing on the playground are laughing loudly.
items.hint: Active (children do action) + present (now). 1st conj: играют → играющие.
items.explanation: Active present plural: играющие (1st conj: играют → играющие). Playing right now.

errorCorrection.hint: The book receives the action (passive), not performs it (active).
errorCorrection.explanation: Читающая is active (who reads). The book is being read (passive): читаемая.

errorCorrection.sentence: Человек, построенный этот дом, живёт здесь.
errorCorrection.hint: The person performed the building (active), not received it (passive).
errorCorrection.explanation: Построенный is passive (what was built). The person built it (active): построивший.

errorCorrection.hint: The student solved the problem (active), not was solved (passive).
errorCorrection.explanation: Решённый is passive (what was solved). The student did the solving (active): решивший.
